message: Water is coming up through the kitchen floor, looks like a burst pipe under the sink.
The bathroom sink has been dripping slowly for a couple of weeks.
One of the outlets in the living room is sparking when I plug anything in.
The hallway light has a flickering light every evening, not urgent.
The fridge stopped cooling overnight, everything inside is warm.
I'm locked out, my key broke off in the front door lock.
Just wanted to ask about the building's recycling schedule.
